name: Mailtrap MCP
description: Sends transactional and bulk email, tests messages in a sandbox, and manages templates and sending stats in Mailtrap from AI assistants via MCP.

skills.name: Send Email
skills.description: Sends a transactional email through the Mailtrap Email API, or batches of transactional and bulk emails in one request.

skills.name: Test in Sandbox
skills.description: Sends test emails to a Mailtrap sandbox, then lists and shows the captured messages so you can check them before going live.

skills.name: Manage Templates
skills.description: Creates, lists, gets, updates, and deletes Mailtrap email templates, for example a new welcome email for onboarding.

skills.name: Read Email Logs
skills.description: Lists email logs and gets the content of a logged message so an assistant can check exactly what was sent and to whom.

skills.name: Get Sending Stats
skills.description: Gets sending stats and email marketing campaign stats for a Mailtrap account so an assistant can report on email performance.
